Annotation Interface MockRepositoryManager

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(TYPE) @ExtendWith(org.codehaus.mojo.mrm.jupiter.MockRepositoryManagerExtension.class) public @interface MockRepositoryManager
The annotation to make use the mock repository manager. Its options should be similar to the mrm-maven-plugin configuration
Since:
2.0.0

    • remoteArtifactSystem

      RemoteArtifactSystem remoteArtifactSystem
      The system for handling downloading artifacts from remote repositories. Within the Maven context these are the repositories defined in the pom.xml, having central defined as the default.
      Returns:
      the local repository configurations
      See Also:
      • LocalRepo
      Default:
